test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 27 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Find the compound interest on a sum of Rs. 25,000, for three years, if the rate of interest is 4% p.a. for the first year, 5% p.a. for the second year and 6% p.a. for the third year.
solution:
Given:

Principal amount, P = 25000

Rate of interest for the 1st year = 4%

Rate of interest for the 2nd year = 5%

Rate of interest for the 3rd year = 6%

Formula used:

A = P[1 + (R/100)]t

Calculation:

For the 1st year,

A1 = 25000 × [1 + (4/100)]

⇒ A1 = 26000

For the 2nd year,

P = A1

A2 = 26000 × [1 + (5/100)]

⇒ A2 = 27300

For the 3rd year,

P = A2

A3 = 27300 × [1 + (6/100)]

⇒ A3 = 28938

CI = AMOUNT - A3 = 28938 - 25000 = Rs. 3,938

∴ The Compound interest at the end of the three years is Rs. 3,938.
